source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Usually dioecious shrub or small tree to ca. 12 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Simple; blades obovate to elliptic-obovate, 6–17 × 5–9 cm, apex usually obtuse, lower surface pubescent; petioles 1.5–6 cm, often reddish or purple
morphology_documented.flowers: Small numerous yellowish white to greenish yellow flowers in terminal panicles ca. 10 cm, enlarging to ca. 30 cm in fruit; sterile pedicels plumose with pale purplish or brownish hairs
morphology_documented.fruit: Flattened kidney-shaped or oblique-oblong, ca. 4 mm long

source_scope_note: Only traits documented in cited flora; null/omitted traits not inferred. Genus-key traits indicated where relevant.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Distinguish introduced C. coggygria: flora describes its smaller ca. 4–9 cm, glabrous, often ovate blades
Flora questions north-central Texas records while citing Edwards Plateau county records; BONAP confirmation needed
preservation: Additive research record; original species.json, photos, credits, and galleries unchanged
